verdict.rationale: Only indirect evidence supports this story. One community user reports they 'could only export a layer', which implies per-layer export exists, though at that time not whole-diagram PDF or JPG. Penpot's docs mention SVG among the open standards available when inspecting code. Missing for 10: documented PNG/SVG/PDF export formats, per-layer export presets, scale multipliers, slice support, and any first-party export documentation or hands-on corroboration.
